heading: Community Blog
intro: Stories, lessons, and notes from across the CIReN network. Move through the showroom and choose a post to read it below.
_comment: The newest date (YYYY-MM-DD) opens by default and comes first, whatever the order here. Each post needs a unique slug, which appears in its link: /blog/?post=slug. New posts arrive from Gmail drafts: see .claude/skills/publish-blog-post/SKILL.md.
